{
 "cwd": "/workspace",
 "query": "MASTER PROMPT – Create a simple static Next.js landing page for an art education project called "Forest Studio Art School". Build only a front-end website, no backend, no login, no database, no real API, no payments, no admin panel. Use static/mock/sample content only. The visual style should feel inspired by nature: forest greens, warm clay, cream paper, botanical textures, soft sunlight, hand-drawn leaf accents, natural watercolor shapes, calm educational atmosphere. The page should be modern, responsive, clean, and easy to read on mobile. Reference feeling: YouTube-style learning page layout, but NOT using YouTube API. Just create static video lesson cards with thumbnail placeholders, play icons, titles, durations, and fake view counts like a curated art learning channel.

Tech requirement: Next.js static site / React components. It should render as a static front-end landing page. Use CSS modules, Tailwind, or plain CSS, whatever is clean. No external service required.

Website type: landing page for an art school that teaches drawing, watercolor, nature journaling, botanical sketching, and creative observation for beginners.

MAIN DESIGN DIRECTION:
- Nature education art theme
- Calm forest-inspired landing page
- Simple structure but polished UI
- Soft gradients, paper texture feeling, rounded cards
- Use leafy dividers, organic blob shapes, botanical icons
- Premium but approachable, not corporate
- Typography: elegant serif for headlines, clean sans-serif for body if possible
- Color palette: sage green, deep pine, moss, cream, terracotta, warm beige, charcoal ink
- Add subtle hover states and smooth scrolling
- Make it fully responsive

REQUIRED PAGE SECTIONS:

1. HERO SECTION
- Full-width hero with soft forest/art classroom background vibe (can use CSS gradient and placeholder image blocks)
- Headline: "Learn Art From Nature"
- Subheadline: "Beginner-friendly drawing and watercolor lessons inspired by forests, flowers, birds, and quiet outdoor observation."
- CTA buttons: "Start Learning" and "View Lessons"
- Add a mock video preview card on the right like a YouTube lesson card: thumbnail placeholder with leaf sketch, play button, title "Watercolor Leaves for Beginners", duration badge "12:45"
- Include small trust badges: "Static lessons", "Beginner friendly", "Nature journal prompts"

2. FEATURED LESSONS / YOUTUBE-STYLE STATIC VIDEO GRID
- Title: "Featured Nature Art Lessons"
- Grid of static video cards inspired by a YouTube homepage layout
- Each card should have thumbnail, play icon overlay, duration, title, instructor name, category, fake views, short description
- Example lessons:
  - Watercolor Leaves for Beginners
  - Sketching Birds With Simple Shapes
  - Forest Color Palette Basics
  - Nature Journaling: 10 Minute Page
  - Botanical Line Drawing
  - Painting Mushrooms in Gouache
- Do not embed real YouTube videos, no API, no external data. Just static cards.

3. INFINITE SCROLL FEEL SECTION
- Requirement: implement an infinite-scroll style experience on the landing page using static/mock lesson arrays. It can load more cards from local data when the user scrolls near bottom or clicks/auto-appends. No backend.
- Section title: "Keep Exploring Lessons"
- Start with a set of lesson cards and simulate more appearing as the user scrolls, using local sample content only.
- Keep it simple and lightweight. If actual infinite scroll logic is too much, make a static repeated feed with sticky label "scroll for more inspiration", but preferred: local mock array + IntersectionObserver.
- Cards should continue the YouTube-inspired visual language but match nature/art branding.

4. ABOUT THE SCHOOL
- Title: "A gentle art classroom rooted in nature"
- Short paragraph explaining that Forest Studio Art School helps students slow down, observe natural forms, and build drawing confidence.
- Add 3 feature blocks:
  - Observe: learn to notice shapes, patterns, light
  - Sketch: practice simple drawing foundations
  - Paint: build color confidence with watercolor and gouache

5. COURSE PATH / LEARNING JOURNEY
- Simple timeline or steps:
  Step 01: Gather materials
  Step 02: Learn simple shapes
  Step 03: Practice nature studies
  Step 04: Build a seasonal sketchbook
- Each step has small icon and short text.

6. CATEGORIES
- Static category chips/cards:
  - Watercolor
  - Botanical Drawing
  - Nature Journaling
  - Bird Sketching
  - Color Theory
  - Outdoor Creativity
- Clicking can just visually be links/anchors, no real filtering required unless simple client-side static filtering is easy.

7. STUDENT GALLERY / SAMPLE WORK
- Display a responsive grid of mock student artwork cards.
- Use placeholder blocks or CSS illustrated cards, no real upload system.
- Captions like "Fern value study", "Autumn leaf palette", "Tiny bird sketch".

8. TESTIMONIALS
- 3 short testimonials from fictional students.
- Keep tone warm and realistic.

9. NEWSLETTER / CTA
- Static sign-up design only. No real form submission/backend. If form included, prevent default and show a small static success message like "Thanks! This is a demo sign-up."
- Headline: "Start your first nature sketch this week"
- Button: "Join the Free Mini Lesson"

10. FOOTER
- Include logo text "Forest Studio"
- Static links: Lessons, About, Gallery, Journal, Contact
- Small note: "Static educational landing page demo"

INTERACTIONS:
- Smooth anchor navigation
- Hover effects on lesson cards
- Static video cards with play icon; clicking can open a simple modal/lightbox with mock lesson details, but no video streaming required
- Infinite scroll with local sample content if possible
- Optional category filter using local data only
- Newsletter demo success message only

CONTENT STYLE:
- Friendly, calm, educational
- Use realistic copy, not lorem ipsum
- Keep everything suitable for art beginners and nature lovers
- No complex app features
- No admin, no student login, no accounts, no real course purchase

DELIVERABLE:
- A complete static Next.js landing page
- Componentized and clean
- Responsive design
- Mock lesson data stored locally in the code
- Must run without any external API or backend
- Make it look like a polished nature-themed art education landing page with a YouTube-inspired lesson feed and infinite scrolling lesson discovery.",
 "judge": {
  "model": "meta-llama/Llama-4-Maverick-17B-128E-Instruct-FP8",
  "model_sha": "94125d2bd83076b21eed33119525e29eaf3894f4",
  "request_model": "meta-llama/Llama-4-Maverick-17B-128E-Instruct-FP8:novita",
  "provider": "novita",
  "pinned_on": "2026-10-09",
  "temperature": 0,
  "max_tokens": 1024,
  "rubric_id": "rva1:mean(visual,query,asset)"
 }
}

"""Grade a Webdev task as the explorer does (verl recipes/design webdev-eval): render, shrink, judge.

No index.html in dist/ scores 0. A render that fails, or a judge that never answers, writes no reward (not scored):
neither says anything about the page."""
import base64
import io
import json
import os
import random
import subprocess
import sys
import time
import urllib.request
from pathlib import Path

sys.path.insert(0, "/tests")
os.environ["WEBDEV_GRADE_HTTP"] = "1"   # serve over loopback http so React/Vue/ES-module sites actually run
from webdev.eval_rubric import build_prompt  # noqa: E402
from webdev.shot import _build_shot_cmd, _parse_render_env, _parse_shot_b64  # noqa: E402
from webdev.verdict import parse_verdict  # noqa: E402

cfg = json.loads(Path("/tests/grade.json").read_text())
V = Path("/logs/verifier")
V.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
dist = Path(cfg["cwd"]) / "dist"


def done(reward: float | None, why: str, **extra) -> None:
    (V / "result.json").write_text(json.dumps({"reward": reward, "summary": why, **extra}, indent=1))
    print(why)
    if reward is None:
        print("not scored", file=sys.stderr)
        sys.exit(1)
    (V / "reward.txt").write_text(f"{reward}\n")
    sys.exit(0)


files = sorted(str(p.relative_to(dist)) for p in dist.rglob("*") if p.is_file())[:200] if dist.is_dir() else []
if "index.html" not in files:
    done(0.0, "The agent delivered nothing to dist/." if not files else "dist/ has no index.html, so there is no page to open.",
         delivered=files)
res = subprocess.run(["sh", "-c", _build_shot_cmd(f"file://{dist}/index.html")], capture_output=True, text=True,
                     timeout=150)   # SHOT_TIMEOUT_S
shot = {"output": (res.stdout or "") + "\n" + (res.stderr or "")}
shot_b64, console_errors = _parse_shot_b64(shot)
render_env = _parse_render_env(shot)
if render_env.get("proxy_failed") or not shot_b64:
    print(shot["output"][-2000:], file=sys.stderr)
    done(None, "external assets were unreachable on every route" if render_env.get("proxy_failed")
         else "the screenshot produced no image")
jpg = base64.b64decode(shot_b64)
try:   # eval_mode._shrink: the judge refuses shots over 20 MP; proportional, quality 75
    from PIL import Image
    Image.MAX_IMAGE_PIXELS = None
    im = Image.open(io.BytesIO(jpg))
    size = im.size
    if im.width * im.height > 20e6:
        k = (20e6 / (im.width * im.height)) ** 0.5
        im = im.convert("RGB").resize((max(1, int(im.width * k)), max(1, int(im.height * k))), Image.LANCZOS)
        b = io.BytesIO(); im.save(b, "JPEG", quality=75); jpg = b.getvalue(); size = im.size
except ImportError:
    size = None
(V / "screenshot.jpg").write_bytes(jpg)
content = [{"type": "image_url", "image_url": {"url": "data:image/jpeg;base64," + base64.b64encode(jpg).decode()}},
           {"type": "text", "text": build_prompt().format(query=cfg["query"][:1500])}]   # QUERY_CAP
url = os.environ.get("WEBDEV_JUDGE_URL", "https://router.huggingface.co/v1").rstrip("/") + "/chat/completions"
_judge_pin = cfg["judge"]
if os.environ.get("WEBDEV_JUDGE_REVISION") != _judge_pin["model_sha"]:
    done(None, "Judge deployment revision is unbound; not scored.")
(V / "judge_config.json").write_text(json.dumps(_judge_pin, indent=1))
body = json.dumps({"model": cfg["judge"]["request_model"], "temperature": 0, "max_tokens": 1024,  # webdev-temp0-pin@1
                   "messages": [{"role": "user", "content": content}]}).encode()
verdict, last = None, ""
for attempt in range(4):   # JUDGE_RETRIES, with eval_mode's backoff
    if attempt:
        time.sleep(min(60.0, 3.0 * (3 ** (attempt - 1))) * (0.5 + random.random()))
    try:
        req = urllib.request.Request(url, data=body, method="POST", headers={
            "Content-Type": "application/json", "Authorization": f"Bearer {os.environ.get('WEBDEV_JUDGE_KEY', '')}"})
        with urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=180) as r:   # JUDGE_TIMEOUT_S
            _judge_reply = json.loads(r.read())
            if _judge_reply.get("model_revision") != _judge_pin["model_sha"]:
                done(None, "Judge response revision differs from the task pin; not scored.")
            msg = _judge_reply["choices"][0]["message"]
        v = parse_verdict(msg.get("content") or msg.get("reasoning_content") or "")
        if "_failed" not in v:
            verdict = v
            break
        last = v["_failed"]
    except Exception as e:  # noqa: BLE001
        last = f"{type(e).__name__}: {e}"[:200]
if not verdict:
    done(None, f"judge unavailable: {last}")
done(verdict["score"], verdict.get("reason", ""), dims=verdict["dims"], visual=verdict["visual"], screenshot_size=size,
     console_errors=console_errors[:1500] if console_errors not in ("", "[]") else "")

rationale: Use temperature zero and bind the model/provider request and artifact revision; mask absent or mismatched deployment/response revision. Version-aware judge endpoint validation is staged.
